contradictions.nature_of_conflict: Whether Judge John Guthmann ordered MDE to resume Feeding Our Future reimbursements in April 2021. Judicial Branch 2022-09-23: never ordered; MDE resumed voluntarily. Star Tribune / commissioner Senate testimony / Governor Walz: judge ordered payments to resume. The court calls those statements false.
contradictions.possible_reconciliation: The public statements appear to have conflated a December 22, 2020 consent order on processing site applications (not payments) and later sanctions litigation with a nonexistent payment order. Preserve both; do not silently overwrite.
contradictions.notes: Seed contradiction for the corpus. Court system's own statement of the record is S28. Political counter-statements are AGENCY_POSITION of the executive on the narrow ordered-to-pay point.

contradictions.nature_of_conflict: Official FOF conviction count. Last verified DOJ/IRS figure in this corpus is 65 on 2026-04-09 (S11). Journalism/ChatGPT claim 68 as of 2026-07-24 (L01; KSTP also notes a DOJ correction from 70th to 68th). Star Tribune 2026-08-19 says 69 convicted (L02).
contradictions.possible_reconciliation: Later official PRs may exist but were not captured (USAO-MN Akamai blocks). Until a matching .gov page is retrieved, 68/69 remain LEAD_UNVERIFIED.

contradictions.nature_of_conflict: Adequacy of MDE oversight. OLA: inadequate; actions and inactions created opportunities for fraud. Commissioner Jett (2024-06-07): MDE’s oversight met applicable standards and MDE made effective referrals; responsibility lies with indicted/convicted fraudsters.
contradictions.possible_reconciliation: OLA is an audit conclusion (B/C). MDE’s letter is AGENCY_POSITION. They can coexist as disagreement; neither is a criminal finding against MDE officials (not D).
contradictions.notes: Do not collapse the dispute into a single 'MDE committed fraud' or 'MDE did nothing wrong' headline.

contradictions.possible_reconciliation: Different vintages and metrics (charging alleged_loss vs agency recap). Treat as MAY_OVERLAP, not additive.
contradictions.notes: Neither figure is a court-certified network restitution total.
